newsitem.title: USA: PRI backlog hits record level in March qtr.
newsitem.headline: PRI backlog hits record level in March qtr.

text.p: PRI Automation Inc, a supplier of factory automation systems to the semiconductor industry, said its second quarter ending backlog was a record $113 million this period, an increase of 31 percent over the backlog for the same period last year.
Earlier, the company said earnings per share for the second quarter was $0.52, up from $0.44 per share last year.

"We are pleased to report that PRI has been able to report record bookings despite continued softness in the semiconductor manufacturing industry," stated Mitch Tyson, president and chief operating officer of PRI Automation.
